text: DECISION 1: YES — the default of CHATROOM_MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN stays at 12. Evidence: src/hub.ts:62 `static MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN = Number(process.env.CHATROOM_MAX_ROOMS_PER_RUN ?? 12)` is env-overridable; src/hub.ts:98-101 counts only rooms in state "open" sharing one swarm-<id> prefix (Hub.runPrefix, hub.ts:72-75), so concluded rooms free slots and non-swarm rooms are uncapped; large runs already override it explicitly (skills/swarm/SKILL.md:40 sets 100 for the 40-seat lobby, skills/swarm/SKILL.md:86 lists 40 among the "Normal values" an operator sets explicitly, as a bundle with five other raised caps, for swarm launches). Those documented values are opt-in settings for a deliberately launched swarm hub, not a reason to raise the unconfigured default: 12 is the safe floor for a dev or unconfigured hub, where any seat can open rooms (join_room auto-creates; request_agent new_room) and the cap is the only bound on runaway break-out rooms per run. Raising the default would loosen that bound for every hub that did not ask for it, while operators who need more already set it in one env var; it matches the sibling per-room cap MAX_LIVE_PER_ROOM=12 at src/hub.ts:63; no script under scripts/ asserts on the value, so there is no evidence of a failure that a different default would fix.
